messages:
maria: QuillFinance procurement needs a one-page pen-test attestation + SOC2 excerpt for the dedicated POC (staging.provision.quill). They want explicit env name and test date. Can we deliver by 2025-03-14?
raj: confirm if they need full report or just attestation. full reports need NDA/legal.
sam: we can provide a signed attestation and a SOC2 summary extract. no raw vuln output without NDA.
maria: they requested wording: "pen test performed on 2025-03-10 against dedicated POC". ok?
olivia: legal: fine to attest date/env. add clause that this is not certification for any framework and that full reports require NDA; do not name third-party tester.
sam: draft attestation: "Redwood Inference attests an independent penetration test was performed against the environment designated "POC - dedicated staging" on 2025-03-10. Findings requiring remediation were addressed by 2025-03-13. This attestation does not certify compliance with any regulatory framework. The full report can be provided under mutual NDA; our standard redaction removes attacker PII and operational secrets. Contact security-legal@redwood.com for delivery instructions."
raj: I'll upload a sanitized network diagram + one-page control matrix to presigned S3 by EOD 2025-03-12.
deploy-bot: Use presigned S3/SFTP for artifacts; do not email sensitive attachments.
maria: I will confirm with procurement whether they accept redacted attestation or want tester-direct delivery. will update. :thumbsup:
